info.description: ThreatLens v3 — Digital Risk Protection: Social & App Monitoring

get.description: Service readiness probe verifying essential subsystems (no secrets exposed).
System metadata, enum catalog, scoring thresholds, and supported platforms.
Get brand profile details and asset count.

patch.description: Update permitted fields of a brand profile.

get.description: Get brand monitoring overview aggregates, funnel metrics, and coverage.
List cleared items for a brand with optional filtering and pagination.
List audit events for a brand ordered newest first.

post.description:
Generate draft asset metadata from store link or platform identifier.

Does NOT persist any asset. Never fetches arbitrary user URLs.
Unallowlisted URLs return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR with BLOCKED_URL details.
Register an official or authorized partner asset.

get.description: List official assets for a brand with filtering and pagination.
Get registered asset details by asset ID.

patch.description: Update or deactivate an asset. Writes an audit event.

post.description:
Start an asynchronous scan job.

Enforces:
- 409 SCAN_ALREADY_RUNNING if a scan is already running for the brand.
- 422 MODE_NOT_ALLOWED if mode is LIVE and simulated sources are requested.
- DEMO mode ignores source_ids for live providers and runs fixtures only.

get.description: List historical scans ordered newest first.
Get scan progress, per-source outcomes, funnel counts, and event log.
Get candidate findings surfaced in this specific scan.
Get candidates cleared by identity rules or benign gates in this scan.

Retrieve external source coverage and connectivity status.

Returns fixed list of 9 source IDs per Section 11.1.
Google Play, Instagram, X and Facebook are explicitly NOT_CONNECTED.
When refresh=True, performs a live health check for connected adapters.
